samples.summary: Read-only engine mounts outside SheetView inherit the new "plain click opens the link" behaviour and lose cell selection
samples.evidence: `handleMouseDown` now opens a link on an unmodified left click whenever `this.readOnly` is true (packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:3678-3691) and `return`s before the selection path. Three other frontend surfaces mount the engine with `readOnly: true` and were not considered: `packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/datasource-view.tsx:65`, `packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/lakehouse-view.tsx:114`, and `packages/frontend/src/components/history/revision-preview.tsx:474`. In the datasource/lakehouse result grids the cell contents are arbitrary query results, so a row holding a URL can no longer be selected or copied — a plain click navigates the user away to a third-party origin instead. The revision preview (a dialog) likewise navigates away on a click that used to select. The fix probably belongs on the new code: gate the modifier-free open on something the host opts into, rather than on `readOnly`.

samples.summary: Only SheetView wires `onLinkHover`; other Spreadsheet mounts get the pointer/click behaviour without the hover card
samples.evidence: `Spreadsheet.onLinkHover` (packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:417-425) is registered only in packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/sheet-view.tsx:1082. The other engine consumers — datasource-view.tsx:62, lakehouse-view.tsx:111, components/history/revision-preview.tsx:474, harness/visual/sheet-scenarios.tsx:721, harness/interaction/page.tsx:371 — never register it, so in those surfaces the pointer turns and a click navigates but no card, and hence no affordance explaining the navigation, ever appears. Not broken, but out of step with the feature's contract.

samples.summary: Link colors hardcoded in the popover duplicate the engine's theme tokens and will drift
samples.evidence: `text-[#1A73E8] dark:text-[#8AB4F8]` in SheetLinkPopover.tsx:73 restates `cellLinkColor` from packages/sheets/src/view/theme.ts:10 (light `#1A73E8`) and theme.ts:51 (dark `#8AB4F8`). A change to the engine token will silently leave the popover a different colour from the underlined span it belongs to.

samples.summary: New zoom-aware `isInsideGrid` is not used by the neighbouring raw header comparisons in the same handler
samples.evidence: `isInsideGrid` scales `RowHeaderWidth`/`DefaultCellHeight` by zoom (worksheet.ts:914-918) and the link branch now uses it, but the checkbox/list-arrow branch immediately below still compares raw CSS pixels (`x > RowHeaderWidth && y > DefaultCellHeight`, worksheet.ts:3700-3701), as do the corner/header checks at worksheet.ts:3744 and 3753. Those sites still work at zoom 1 but are now inconsistent with the helper this change introduced, so the two rules will disagree at any other zoom.

samples.summary: Task doc still cites the deleted `packages/sheets/src/view/url-detect.ts`
samples.evidence: docs/tasks/active/20260917-sheets-cell-link-spans-todo.md:6 references `packages/sheets/src/view/url-detect.ts:18`, and docs/tasks/archive/2026/07/20260724-sheets-cell-hyperlink-todo.md:21,33 reference the same file and `cellHyperlink`. The file is deleted by this change. Nothing in CI checks paths in task docs (only top-level docs/design/*.md are link-checked), so this will not be caught mechanically.

verdict.reason: The described code is present and behaves as claimed: worksheet.ts:3678-3691 opens a link via window.open on an unmodified single left click whenever `this.readOnly` is true, returning before every selection path (selection handling starts at worksheet.ts:3743). Link spans are auto-detected from plain cell text (gridcanvas.ts:1696 -> recordRenderedLink at 1833/1926; cell-links.test.ts:55-57 shows a bare URL string becomes a span), so arbitrary query-result text containing a URL is a live navigation target. The engine exposes no host opt-in for this — Options in spreadsheet.ts:25-32 only has `readOnly`, which is forwarded to Worksheet (spreadsheet.ts:82, worksheet.ts:307-314). All three cited consumers exist and mount with `readOnly: true`: datasource-view.tsx:62-65 (grid populated by loadQueryResults at line 108), lakehouse-view.tsx:111-114, revision-preview.tsx:471-475. Read-only mounts still support selection (the readOnly checks at 3626/3635/3647/3818/3974 gate only mutation/drag paths), so these surfaces lose click-to-select on link-bearing cells and instead navigate to a third-party origin. No guard, caller-side interception, or flag makes these sites exempt; this is a behaviour change to an exported symbol with unconsidered consumers — squarely in the blast-radius lane.
